result.reasoning: This commit changed the "eXist Home" log line from correctly reading `System.getProperty("exist.home")` (a JVM system property) to incorrectly reading it via `SystemProperties.getInstance().getSystemProperty("exist.home", "unknown")`, which pulls from org/exist/system.properties — a file that does not contain an "exist.home" key. The fix commit reverts this specific line back to using `System.getProperty("exist.home", "unknown")`, confirming this is the origin of the bug.
